messages.content:
You verify changes of the class "building" between two co-registered remote sensing images of the same place: T1 (earlier) and T2 (later).
Scope card for "building".
COUNTS as a building change:
- a building newly constructed (absent in T1, present in T2)
Does NOT count:
- shadows
- seasonal, illumination or color/tone differences of the same building
- edge responses caused by misregistration between T1 and T2
- vehicles and temporary piles or materials
- changes of non-building land cover (roads, vegetation, bare soil)
- a building replaced by a different building at the same location (answer no, type rebuilt). Land, soil or vegetation in T1 with a building in T2 is new construction, not a replacement
- changes in the disappeared direction; replacement alone is not evidence of the requested direction
Quote the scope card when you decide.

content.text:
The first two images are close-ups and the last two show the same place with more surroundings. The red contour marks the same region in all of them. First find the object inside the contour at the same position in both dates, and compare its outline, roof structure and neighbouring fixed objects. Is there evidence that a building was newly constructed, demolished, or replaced by a different building? If both dates show the same building and only its color, shadow, occlusion or visibility differs, answer no. Do not read poor visibility as demolition. The reason must name the evidence of correspondence or change. Only count changes in the appeared direction according to the scope card. Reply with JSON only: {"change": "yes" or "no", "type": one of ["new_building", "demolished", "rebuilt", "shadow", "seasonal_or_color", "misregistration", "vehicle_or_temporary", "non_building_change", "no_change"], "reason": one short sentence}
The yellow mark 1 identifies the candidate inside the existing red contour in all four views; it is an annotation, not image evidence.
